summary: Practical rail operations and safety management training. Build risk controls, incident response, and KPI dashboards. Enroll to strengthen rail safety.
lede: Rail Operations and Safety Management helps you plan, control, and improve train movement, trackside activity, maintenance isolation, and other safety-critical work. You will learn to assess operational risk, apply operating rules, coordinate movement authority and track access, and strengthen incident response using practical controls informed by ISO 45001, ISO 31000, and Bow-tie analysis. The course develops hands-on capability through a rail baseline assessment, control checklist, incident response plan, risk registers, defect logs, dashboards, and corrective action trackers. You will also explore AI-assisted anomaly detection and digital inspection workflows, using inspection findings, shift reports, and incident records to support safer operations, compliance reviews, and disciplined service recovery.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work inside rail operations, safety, maintenance, or assurance and need a more structured way to manage control and reporting. It speaks directly to the people who keep trains moving, keep worksites protected, and keep safety evidence credible.
modules: Rail Operating Controls and Rule Compliance
Rail Asset Integrity and Maintenance Safety
prerequisites: You should already understand basic rail terminology, operational routines, or maintenance workflows. Bring a laptop and, where possible, a sample incident log, inspection sheet, shift handover note, or KPI report from your current rail context.
